$comment: Pronunciation overrides for the voice-over (owner: voiceover-tool; see reference/story/voice.md). `word` is matched whole-word and case-insensitively in the spoken text; `ph` is in misaki's British phoneme alphabet (the symbols Kokoro's bf_ and bm_ voices take: A=eɪ I=aɪ Q=əʊ W=aʊ Y=ɔɪ, ˈ primary stress, ˌ secondary, ː long). The text sent to the engine becomes [Odoo](/ˈuːduː/), so the word stays in the token list and keeps its timing and its place in the caption. `say` is how a person would write it out loud. Only add a name when the default is wrong or unstable: the build prints which entries a family used. An edit here re-records exactly the clips whose spoken text it changes (--stale).

entries.note: Koodo Reader. Pinned so a G2P change cannot move it.
The extra i is part of the name; the default reads two short i sounds.
The default spells it out letter by letter.
The default puts a primary stress on every syllable.
The sign-off. The default splits it in two with a pause.
